routeTitles./: Shadow | Let your agent buy services on a budget you set

socialDescriptions./: Arc testnet, test USDC only. Set aside USDC and limits for your agent. It signs each purchase from its own wallet; the contract pays the provider only inside those limits and records what is owed.
socialDescriptions./start: Arc testnet, test USDC only. Set aside USDC for an agent's purchases. Track what it owes and reclaim eligible funds from your own wallet.
socialDescriptions./evidence: This page brings the Float board and supporting records together.
socialDescriptions./builders: The public browser flow starts at /start on Arc testnet: a sponsor funds a line, an agent submits and repays a purchase, then the sponsor closes the line and reclaims the remaining reserve.
socialDescriptions./builders/v2: These tools are for the earlier Float V2 contract; the current public testnet browser flow starts at /start.
socialDescriptions./funding: Earlier candidate funding information for Shadow. The current public browser flow starts at /start on Arc testnet.
socialDescriptions./guarded-testnet: Guarded testnet funding for Shadow. This route is for the controlled Arc testnet flow.
socialDescriptions./mainnet: A controlled Arc mainnet candidate for sponsor-backed agent purchases, with a 0.10 USDC reserve cap and a 0.005 USDC purchase limit per line. The public participant flow is on Arc testnet.
socialDescriptions./roadmap: Shadow product status. Today's browser flow is self-service; see current use, history, and open work.
